answer_1.quote: This work introduces CEval, the first comprehensive benchmark for evaluating methods that modify text to change classifier predictions, including contrastive explanations, counterfactual generation, and adversarial attacks.

answer_2.quote: We use two types of metrics: counterfactual metrics, which reflect the counterfactual criteria outlined above, and textual quality metrics, which assess the quality of the generated text, irrespective of its counterfactual properties.

answer_3.quote: In this work, we use ChatGPT (gpt-3.5-turbo-0125) with a temperature of 0.2 to evaluate the above textual quality metrics on a scale from 1 to 5 following .
